record.title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy
record.description:
Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy collects Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Justice for All, and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Trials and Tribulations. Across 14 episodes, players investigate crime scenes, collect evidence, question witnesses and defend clients in court.

Courtroom sequences revolve around identifying contradictions between testimony and evidence, while investigation sections focus on examining locations and speaking with characters. The current Nintendo Switch version also includes added accessibility and gallery features such as Episode Selection, Story Mode, Auto-play, a Music Player, an Art gallery and a Scene Creator.

Police stations, offices, homes and unusual locations feed evidence into courtroom confrontations where testimony, logic and character motives drive the central puzzles.

record.verdictSummary:
Score note: 8.1/10 is a direct normalization of the current 81/100 Metacritic aggregate for the Nintendo listing; it is not a separately invented store rating.

The trilogy remains one of the strongest entry points into Ace Attorney because its three-game structure combines memorable mysteries, recurring characters and courtroom logic in one package, with later quality-of-life additions reducing friction for new players.
verdictPros: Three full Ace Attorney games and 14 episodes in one release.
Excellent character writing and satisfying contradiction-based courtroom puzzles.
Modern convenience and gallery features improve accessibility.
verdictCons: Large amount of reading may not suit action-focused players.
Some investigation sequences can require very specific interactions.

faq.a: It adds story co-op, new side stories, difficulty settings, quality-of-life improvements, and all DLC from the Wii U version.

Yes, as backward-compatible Nintendo Switch software.

faq.q: Is Nintendo Switch Online required for the main story?
faq.a: No. The main story and local co-op do not require Nintendo Switch Online.

faq.q: How is it different from Pikmin 4?
faq.a: Pikmin 3 Deluxe focuses on three captains and food collection, while Pikmin 4 introduces a different rescue-corp structure and Oatchi.

record.title: Pikmin 4
record.description: Pikmin 4 expands Nintendo’s miniature strategy-adventure formula with a customizable Rescue Corps rookie, the canine companion Oatchi, Ice Pikmin, Glow Pikmin, deeper cave expeditions, nighttime missions, and Dandori challenges. It is designed to be accessible to newcomers while giving series veterans a large campaign with layered exploration and postgame content.

gameplayPillars.title: Oatchi companion systems
gameplayPillars.description: Ride Oatchi, command him independently, carry heavy objects, battle creatures, and upgrade his skills.

gameplayPillars.title: New Pikmin types
gameplayPillars.description: Ice Pikmin can freeze water and enemies, while Glow Pikmin appear in nighttime expeditions.

gameplayPillars.title: Caves and layered exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Caves return with multi-level structures, treasure hunts, hazards, bosses, and flexible planning.

gameplayPillars.title: Dandori efficiency challenges

gameplayPillars.description: Defend Lumiknolls after dark using Glow Pikmin in a different style of mission from daytime exploration.

record.worldSummary: The game transforms ordinary human environments into enormous miniature landscapes, including gardens, interiors, caves, beaches, and nighttime zones full of hidden treasures and creatures.

storyChapters.title: Join the Rescue Corps
storyChapters.body: A new recruit arrives to help a rescue mission after Captain Olimar and other castaways become stranded.

storyChapters.title: Recover castaways and treasure
storyChapters.body: Every area contains stranded people, resources, and treasures that expand the Rescue Corps’ capabilities.

storyChapters.title: Explore caves and night missions
storyChapters.body: The campaign layers conventional daytime maps with caves and defensive nighttime expeditions.

storyChapters.title: Push into the late rescue operation
